desc: DORAEMON on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B9 (robust RL), the adaptive form of
the domain randomisation that dr_ippo does with a fixed uniform range.
Source: Tiboni et al., ICLR 2024, arXiv:2311.01885; code
gabrieletiboni/doraemon.
Host block == ippo/config1.json. The learner is URB's IPPO and is never
told sigma; only the distribution the environment draws from changes.
dr_range = [0, 3]   B9's range verbatim, the same support as dr_ippo.
init_beta_param = 100   the released code's default (Beta(100,100)),
i.e. start narrow and let the entropy objective widen it.
alpha = 0.5   the desired success rate. The paper states it selected 0.5
for ALL of its experiments; it is not tuned here.
kl_ub = 0.05  the KL trust region. The paper grid-searches this per
environment over roughly 0.001 .. 0.1; 0.05 is the middle of the
range they report and was not chosen by looking at URB returns.
beta_param_bounds = [0.5, 200]   the box the optimiser searches, which
keeps the Beta from degenerating to a spike or to a bimodal shape.
update_every_days = 100   the paper's K episodes per distribution update.
warmup_days = 200, perf_lb = null   the success threshold is CALIBRATED
as the median relative excess delay over the first 200 days and then
FROZEN. The paper's success indicator is task-specific by design;
this rule is declared, reproducible and reads nothing from returns.
sigma_floor = 1e-9   same reason as dr_ippo: a draw of exactly 0 falls
off the severity wrapper's bookkeeping path for one day.
